This year, Menlo Park is being put to the test.
The cost of living, intensified immigration enforcement, and threats to our democracy have left our local community focused on surviving instead of thriving.
Instead of coming together, our community has been forced apart over decisions about affordable housing and economic development in the heart of our downtown. The stakes are high: policy decisions made today will impact generations of Menlo Park residents to come. We all deserve to live a life of dignity and happiness. We deserve a future where we have the resources to support all of our neighbors, instead of a select few.
It's time for us to act now.
We need a city council member to bring our city back together to tackle the hardest issues facing us now and in the future. We need a city council member who has the relationships and the will to lift our community’s voice to the powers that be to make sure we always have the final say. I am ready and willing to be that city council member.
Menlo Park losing local control stops with me.
While we all have different life experiences and circumstances, I truly believe that government can meet us where we are - from right here at home, all the way up to the state capitol. I will rebuild trust with our government and won't let bureaucracy and inaction get in the way of the best Menlo Park possible.
Let's make Menlo Park the best place to live life, do business, raise a family, and age in place. Join us.

# Endorsements
I'm proud to have the support of residents, business owners, and community leaders across Menlo Park and beyond in the 2026 election for City Council District 4. These endorsements reflect a shared belief that District 4 needs someone who knows its community, its residents, and its character to lead it forward.
As a communications professional, community organizer and - most importantly - as a Menlo Park resident, I am growing a coalition based on trust and a shared vision for the future of District 4 and our entire city.
Come join our movement, we'd be honored to have you. Click here to add your endorsement today.
